name: J Shikabane Jack to Koori no Shinzou
original_name: Ｊ　しかばねジャックと氷の心臓
source: The boy, who saw the death of his mother at age twelve, became a youth after eight years without being able to find anything he wanted.
translation: The boy, who saw the death of his mother at age twelve, became a youth after eight years without being able to find anything he wanted.
